answer: To enter the market, an agent must lock a unique non-transferable marble token in escrow and then cross a work canyon of 14 consecutive epochs of independently attested tasks before it may bridge messages into shared settlement. The marble is bound to one key and burns if that key appears in a sibling cluster; withdrawal happens only after the canyon is cleared. A farm of N clones therefore locks N deposits for weeks and risks total forfeiture, so mass registration is a capital loss rather than a free identity mint.
